claimed: Any page under a versioned CKEditor docs URL is also available as Markdown by swapping .html for .md (e.g. https://ckeditor.com/docs/ckeditor5/47.6.0/getting-started/index.md).
corrected: The Markdown variants (.md suffix and the Accept: text/markdown header) exist only under /latest/. On versioned docs URLs the .md suffix returns 404 and the Accept header silently returns HTML (content-type text/html). Versioned docs must be read as HTML; use the /latest/ .md pages only for convenience and verify version-sensitive content against the pinned HTML docs.
reasoning_failure: Generalized the AI-coding-agents page's .md convention (documented against latest) to all versioned docs URLs without testing a versioned URL in both access modes; the Accept-header case is extra deceptive because it returns HTTP 200.
